elements.label: Figure 10.2
elements.title: The executive dashboard is a visual representation of data to give executives and senior management a quick, real-time overview of an organization's key performance indicators (KPIs).
elements.details: Photo of a tablet screen showing an executive dashboard with multiple visual elements: a pie chart labeled 'Traffic Sources Overview' with categories Direct Traffic, Search Engines, Referral Sites; a line chart labeled 'Visitors Overview' showing a time series with peaks and troughs; a map labeled 'Map Overlay'; and a table labeled 'Content Overview' with unreadable text. The tablet is on a wooden table with a blurred background including a white cup and a pen.
elements.summary: This image illustrates an executive dashboard used to provide a quick, real-time overview of key performance indicators for executives and senior management, demonstrating how data visualization supports decision-making.
